# Reviewed public WRITE REST routes (permission_callback = __return_true).
#
# Format: METHOD /namespace/path   (one per line; '#' starts a comment)
#
# Key notes:
#   *        a dynamic fragment (variable-derived namespace/path)
#   {CONST}  an unresolved class constant
#
# Every entry needs a human review of its compensating controls. When a route
# stops being public, remove its entry — the CI gate fails on stale entries.

# Base plugin — MCP JSON-RPC transport. Authentication is enforced inside the
# controller (bearer credential / OAuth token); the public surface is the
# protocol handshake, which must answer unauthenticated probes with a typed 401.
POST /{REST_NAMESPACE}/mcp

# Base plugin — inbound workflow trigger receiver. HMAC-SHA256 over the exact
# body is required (fail closed when no secret is configured) and the trigger
# must be enabled. The trigger CPT is private; drafts are legitimate config
# records, so `_wp_mcp_ai_trigger_enabled` (not post_status) is the live flag.
POST /mcp-ai/v1/orchestration/triggers/webhook/(?P<id>\d+)

# Pro + Content Graph Pro — RFC 7591 dynamic client registration. Public by
# protocol design; DCR only issues a client_id/secret and is rate-limited.
POST /*/oauth/register

# Pro + Content Graph Pro — RFC 6749 token endpoint. Client authentication plus
# the PKCE code exchange are the proof.
POST /*/oauth/token

# Pro + Content Graph Pro — RFC 7009 revocation. Client authentication is the
# proof; revoking an already-invalid token is a no-op.
POST /*/oauth/revoke

# Pro — Telegram Mini App initData validation. The callback verifies Telegram's
# HMAC over the initData payload before trusting any field.
POST /*/*/validate

# Pro — public booking surface. Honeypot + mandatory consent + per-IP rate
# limit, and the target link must be active AND published.
POST /nvoos-outbound/v1/bookings

# Content Graph AI — MCP JSON-RPC transport (same contract as the base route).
POST /mcp-ai/v1/mcp

# Forge Bridge — anonymous form submissions. Origin allowlist (CSRF gate),
# per-IP rate limit, honeypot + timestamp ladder, optional Turnstile,
# published-form visibility check, and routing carriers stripped from fields.
POST /nvoos-forge/v1/forms/submit

# Forge Bridge — single-use preview-token verification. The bearer token is the
# proof; constant-time comparison and consumption.
POST /nvoos-forge/v1/preview-tokens/verify
